gaps.title: Encryption Deficiency on 'teststorage2'
gaps.description: Resource 'teststorage2' (StorageAccount) does not enforce required cryptographic protections (HTTPS-only or customer-managed key encryption at rest).
gaps.remediation_guidance: az storage account update --name teststorage2 --https-only true --min-tls-version TLS1_2
gaps.hitl_action: Verify operational impact before applying infrastructure configuration changes.

gaps.title: Insecure Network Security Rule on 'nsg-test'
gaps.description: Network security group 'nsg-test' permits overly permissive ingress/egress rules, violating network boundary isolation requirements under GDPR.
gaps.remediation_guidance: az network nsg rule update --resource-group <rg> --nsg-name nsg-test --name <rule-name> --access Deny --source-address-prefixes '0.0.0.0/0'
gaps.hitl_action: Verify operational impact before applying infrastructure configuration changes.

gaps.title: Redundancy / Disaster Recovery Gap on 'teststorage2'
gaps.description: Resource 'teststorage2' uses local-only redundancy (LRS), failing cross-regional disaster resilience requirements under GDPR (e.g. DORA Art. 11, NIS2 Art. 21).
gaps.remediation_guidance: az storage account update --name teststorage2 --sku Standard_GRS
gaps.hitl_action: Verify operational impact before applying infrastructure configuration changes.

remediation_steps: az storage account update --name teststorage2 --https-only true --min-tls-version TLS1_2
az network nsg rule update --resource-group <rg> --nsg-name nsg-test --name <rule-name> --access Deny --source-address-prefixes '0.0.0.0/0'
az storage account update --name teststorage2 --sku Standard_GRS
